2121766826631999489.en_summary: On December 9th of the year the EU Product Liability Directive (PLD) will go into effect. For the first time software will have same product liability as physical products. With the recent plane stoppage caused by software & the reckless hacking by leading LLM companies, the US should do the same thing. The creators of the software need to recognize the financial impact that is possible. Which is huge.
2121766826631999489.zh_summary: 今年12月9日，歐盟產品責任指令（PLD）將生效。軟件將首次與實體產品擁有相同的產品責任。鑒於最近由軟件引起的飛機停飛以及領先LLM公司的魯莽黑客行為，美國應該做同樣的事情。軟件創造者需要認識到可能的財務影響。這是巨大的。
